final: WITH a AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len FROM film GROUP BY rating), g AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS overall FROM film), s1 AS (SELECT a.rating, a.avg_len FROM a, g WHERE a.avg_len > g.overall), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_len) AS m FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.rating, s1.avg_len FROM s1, m1 WHERE s1.avg_len > m1.m) SELECT AVG(s2.avg_len) AS mean_remaining, AVG(s2.avg_len - g.overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(s2.avg_len - m1.m) AS avg_above_first_cut_mean FROM s2, g, m1
